# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Added named shrimp body-composition fields to `ShrimpRuntimeParams` with serde-safe defaults, rewired shrimp biomass budget accounting and mortality carcass routing to use those shrimp-specific values instead of the global `feed_n_to_c_ratio`, updated scenario construction to populate the new fields, and strengthened `budget_tracking` regressions so the exact mortality test asserts shrimp-specific carcass detritus while the 200-hour stress test now proves particulate detritus increases as population declines.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Add shrimp-specific body-composition defaults/fields and use them in shrimp biomass accounting helpers instead of the global feed quality ratio.
1. [Completed] Route dead shrimp carcass mass through the shrimp-specific composition helper and update regression coverage to assert shrimp-specific carcass detritus mass plus 200-hour detritus buildup.
2. [Completed] Run formatting and targeted tank_core validation for budget tracking and shrimp mortality/population pathways.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_feeding_pathway`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population`
- `cargo test -p tank_core` progressed through the touched shrimp/budget suites successfully before failing later in `water_change_mass_balance` on the unrelated bicarbonate-ratio assertion noted above.

## Outstanding Risks

- The shared `fine_detritus_g_total` pool still uses pooled detrital `feed_n_to_c_ratio` for downstream elemental accounting, so truly diverging shrimp body-composition overrides would need separate detrital stoichiometry tracking or invariants to preserve conservation outside the default calibrated pair.
- A broader `cargo test -p tank_core` sweep is still not fully green because `crates/tank_core/tests/water_change_mass_balance.rs::water_change_50_percent_ro_like_halves_dissolved_totals` fails on bicarbonate ratio assertions; that path was outside this mortality-routing fix.
